description: This file contains API definitions, type declarations, macros, and external references for the MCU driver in an AUTOSAR-based embedded system. It defines configuration structures, enums, function prototypes, and constants related to MCU initialization, reset, clock management, and interrupt handling.

methods.name: Mcu_Init
methods.description: Initializes the MCU driver with the provided configuration.

methods.name: Mcu_InitClock
methods.description: Initializes the MCU clock with the specified setting.

methods.name: Mcu_DistributePllClock
methods.description: Distributes the PLL clock to the system.

methods.name: Mcu_GetPllStatus
methods.description: Returns the current PLL lock status.

methods.name: Mcu_GetResetReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for the last reset.

methods.name: Mcu_PerformReset
methods.description: Performs a software reset of the MCU.

methods.name: Mcu_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves version information of the MCU driver.

methods.name: McuE_GetClockReferencePointFrequency
methods.description: Returns the clock reference point frequency.

methods.name: McuE_LowPowerRecoverFlash
methods.description: Recovers flash after low power mode.
